name: PubTabNet final evaluation set (ICDAR 2021 Scientific Literature Parsing, task B)
source: https://github.com/ajjimeno/icdar-task-b (linked from the PubTabNet README as the PubTabNet test set and ground truth)
description: Table images cropped from scientific articles in the PubMed Central Open Access commercial-use subset, with HTML ground truth (structure and cell text). English.

licence.name: Annotations: CDLA-Permissive-1.0 (IBM). Images: PMC Open Access Subset terms (commercial-use collection; each article under its own CC0/CC BY/CC BY-SA/CC BY-ND licence).
licence.note: The icdar-task-b repository has no licence file of its own. Orchestrator decision (WO-001 review, 19 Nov 2026): covered by the PubTabNet licence (LICENSE.md above) because it is PubTabNet's own test set. Only page IDs are committed; no images or annotations.

redistribution: conditional: annotations yes (CDLA-Permissive-1.0); images only with each article's attribution. Not redistributed here: manifest and script only.

split.exclude_reason: Ground truth of these 17 tables was shown to the coding agent while the source was being inspected, before the split was fixed (WO-001). Excluded from both splits so no held-out page has been read.

notes: Pages are table crops, not full pages: tables category only.

Training splits of PubTabNet are widely used to train table models; this is the final evaluation set, whose ground truth was released after the 2021 competition. Candidates may still have seen it: treat as possibly contaminated.
Pinned to commit 86a9c80239ffc1d1534a4f63031c861949c982ea; the zip sha256 is the Git LFS object id.
